title: Beyond the Heatmap: A Rigorous Evaluation of Component Impact in MCTS-Based TSP Solvers
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the search and learning components of solvers for the Travelling Salesman Problem. It includes a 'Broader impacts' section (pages 26-27) discussing potential societal consequences such as job displacement and ethical misuse of optimization, but this is an auxiliary section for limitations/reflections and not a primary research component evaluating religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
